subtopics.label: Innate Lymphoid Cells and Mucosal Immune Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on innate lymphoid cell (ILC) biology including ILC2s, ILC3s, and their roles in mucosal immunity, tissue homeostasis, gut barrier function, and inflammatory regulation at barrier surfaces. Includes neuropeptide and cytokine control of ILC responses and ILC interactions with microbiota and adaptive immune cells.
subtopics.short_description: ILC biology and cytokine-driven regulation of gut barrier function, tissue homeostasis, and mucosal inflammation.

subtopics.label: Tumor Immune Microenvironment and Cancer Immunotherapy
subtopics.description: Research on immune cell composition and function within the tumor microenvironment, including T cell exhaustion and activation states, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, macrophage polarization, and mechanisms of immune evasion. Encompasses preclinical and translational studies of immune checkpoint blockade, combination immunotherapy strategies, and tumor immunogenicity.
subtopics.short_description: Immune cell composition, T cell exhaustion, and checkpoint blockade strategies within the tumor microenvironment.

subtopics.label: Cytokine and Interferon Signaling in Immune Responses
subtopics.description: Studies of cytokine pathways including type I, II, and III interferons, interleukins, TNF-alpha, and their downstream signaling in immune and non-immune cells. Covers innate immune activation, antiviral responses, inflammasome biology, and cytokine-mediated regulation of inflammation and immune cell function.
subtopics.short_description: Interferon, interleukin, and TNF-alpha signaling in innate immune activation, inflammasome biology, and inflammatory regulation.

subtopics.label: T Cell Biology, Exhaustion, and Immune Checkpoint Regulation
subtopics.description: Fundamental research on T cell differentiation, activation, exhaustion, and memory formation, including CD4+ and CD8+ T cell subsets, regulatory T cells, and tissue-resident memory T cells. Includes immune checkpoint receptor biology (PD-1, CTLA-4, LAG-3, TIM-3, ICOS, TIGIT, GITR) and small molecule modulation of checkpoint pathways.
subtopics.short_description: CD4+, CD8+, and regulatory T cell biology, exhaustion, memory formation, and checkpoint receptor modulation.

subtopics.label: B Cell Biology, Humoral Immunity, and Antibody Responses
subtopics.description: Research on B cell differentiation, germinal center reactions, antibody class switching, somatic hypermutation, and memory B cell formation. Includes studies of broadly neutralizing antibodies, immunoglobulin structure and function, B cell receptor signaling, and B cell contributions to lymphomagenesis and autoimmunity.
subtopics.short_description: Germinal center reactions, antibody class switching, memory B cell formation, and broadly neutralizing antibody responses.

subtopics.label: Macrophage and Myeloid Cell Biology in Inflammation
subtopics.description: Studies of macrophage activation, polarization, phagocytosis, and inflammatory signaling including microglial biology in the CNS, tissue-resident macrophage function, and myeloid cell roles in infection, sterile inflammation, and tissue repair. Includes macrophage metabolic regulation and exophagy mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Macrophage polarization, microglial function, and myeloid cell roles in infection, sterile inflammation, and tissue repair.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome, Mycobiome, and Immune Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on interactions between the gut microbiota (bacterial and fungal) and host immune responses, including microbiome-driven regulation of mucosal immunity, IgA responses, immune tolerance, and systemic inflammation. Covers fungal commensalism, mycobiome dysbiosis in disease, and microbiota manipulation of immune cell function.
subtopics.short_description: Bacterial and fungal microbiota interactions with mucosal immunity, IgA responses, and systemic inflammatory regulation.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Immune Responses, Vaccines, and COVID-19 Immunopathology
subtopics.description: Research on host immune responses to SARS-CoV-2 infection including antibody dynamics, T cell responses, innate immune activation, and COVID-19 immunopathology such as complement activation, cytokine storm, and vascular inflammation. Includes mRNA vaccine immunogenicity, protection against variants, waning immunity, and breakthrough infections.
subtopics.short_description: Antibody dynamics, T cell responses, cytokine storm, and mRNA vaccine immunogenicity in SARS-CoV-2 infection.

subtopics.label: Neuroinflammation and Neuroimmune Interactions
subtopics.description: Studies of immune cell activity in the central nervous system including microglial activation, neuroinflammatory signaling, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, and neuroimmune crosstalk in neurological diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, stroke, and psychiatric conditions. Includes astrocyte-immune interactions and CNS-specific cytokine responses.
subtopics.short_description: Microglial activation, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, and neuroimmune signaling in neurological and psychiatric diseases.

subtopics.label: HIV Immunology, Immune Dysfunction, and Reservoir Biology
subtopics.description: Research on HIV-specific immune responses, CD4+ and CD8+ T cell dysfunction, immune activation and inflammation in people living with HIV, HIV reservoir formation and latency reversal, and immunotherapeutic strategies for HIV control. Includes studies of broadly neutralizing antibodies against HIV and immune recovery on antiretroviral therapy.
subtopics.short_description: HIV-specific T cell dysfunction, viral reservoir latency, broadly neutralizing antibodies, and immune recovery on antiretroviral therapy.

subtopics.label: Transplant Immunology and Alloimmune Responses
subtopics.description: Research on immune mechanisms of allograft rejection, tolerance, and monitoring in solid organ and hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Includes urinary and blood biomarkers of rejection, donor-specific antibodies, T cell-mediated and antibody-mediated rejection, and immunosuppression strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Allograft rejection mechanisms, donor-specific antibodies, tolerance induction, and biomarker monitoring in transplantation.

subtopics.label: Lymphoma Biology and Hematologic Immune Malignancies
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and immunological mechanisms driving B cell and T cell lymphomas, including epigenetic dysregulation, tumor microenvironment remodeling, immune evasion, and targeted therapeutic vulnerabilities. Covers germinal center biology in lymphomagenesis, CAR T cell therapies for hematologic malignancies, and lymphoma immunotherapy.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and immunological drivers of B and T cell lymphomas, immune evasion, and CAR T cell therapeutic strategies.

subtopics.label: Autoimmunity, Autoreactivity, and Immune Tolerance
subtopics.description: Studies of self-reactive immune responses, breakdown of immune tolerance, and autoimmune mechanisms including type I interferon-driven autoimmunity, autoreactive B and T cells, and molecular triggers of autoimmune pathology. Covers autoimmune conditions such as lupus, type 1 diabetes antigen presentation, and psoriasis immune mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Self-reactive B and T cell responses, interferon-driven autoimmune pathology, and molecular triggers of tolerance failure.

subtopics.label: Vaccine Immunogenicity and Protective Immune Responses
subtopics.description: Research on vaccine-induced humoral and cellular immune responses, including antibody breadth, durability, and effector functions elicited by viral vaccines (CMV, influenza, HIV, rotavirus). Covers adjuvant effects, maternal vaccination, broadly neutralizing antibody induction, and preclinical vaccine development in animal models.
subtopics.short_description: Antibody breadth, durability, and cellular immunity elicited by viral vaccines, adjuvants, and maternal vaccination strategies.

subtopics.label: Inflammatory Signaling, Cellular Senescence, and Sterile Inflammation
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of sterile inflammation including NF-κB, STING, cGAS, and inflammasome pathways, cellular senescence-associated inflammatory phenotypes (SASP), and oxidative stress-driven immune activation. Includes studies of complement activation, necroptosis, and inflammatory mediators in non-infectious tissue injury.
subtopics.short_description: NF-κB, STING, and inflammasome pathways driving senescence-associated inflammation and non-infectious tissue injury.
